status_definitions.announced: Publicly announced / mapping only, no AV testing reported yet
status_definitions.testing: AV testing on public roads (safety driver, no public riders)
status_definitions.safety-driver: Public (or invited) riders with a safety driver or monitor on board (may be paid)
status_definitions.driverless-employees: Rider-only (no human on board) rides for employees/guests only
status_definitions.public-driverless: Rider-only rides for public riders (waitlist or open), free
status_definitions.paid-public: Rider-only rides for public riders with fares

confidence.reported: Number published by company, regulator, or a tracker's own measurement, as-is
confidence.derived: Computed from reported data (polygon area, sums, differences)
confidence.estimate: Modelled estimate with stated method (none in v1)
